blocks.translation:
• To the purchaser — Read this first.
• This product contains small parts. Keep away from small children to prevent accidental swallowing. There is a risk of choking.
• Do not use this product near the ear. Accidental use near the ear may damage hearing.
• Do not put fingers or other body parts into moving parts. There is a risk of being pinched and injured.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED light. Prolonged viewing may cause nausea or other discomfort.
• Improper battery use can cause heating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Install batteries with the correct + and - polarity.
• After playing, always turn off the power and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, recharge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If fluid contacts the skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of batteries, follow your local municipality's waste-disposal instructions.

blocks.translation:
• This product contains precision electronic parts. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it where it will become very hot or very cold.
• Dispose of the plastic packaging immediately after opening.
• Do not place the product on resin (plastic) sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not forcibly pull or bend moving parts or attachment parts in an unnatural direction.
• Some voice lines have different intonation or may be hard to hear because of the product's characteristics.
• This product is made precisely. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• Do not attach this to the PREMIUM DX Memorial Vision Driver except for the Reize Buckle series.
